= camel kubernetes export

Export as Maven project that contains a Kubernetes deployment manifest

NOTE: This command is provided by the `kubernetes` plugin. Install it with `camel plugin add kubernetes`.


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel kubernetes export [options]
----
